description: Asks which environment, path and file-information functions the expression service admits through DAO, called only with names that do not exist (an environment variable R_EXPR_1B_NOVAR and the path C:\r-expr-1b-nofile.txt): CurDir and Dir (also with an attribute argument, and the no-argument continuation), FileLen, FileDateTime and GetAttr on a missing file and on the root directory, Environ and Environ$, Command, and the file-number functions EOF, LOF, Loc, Seek and FreeFile. No process, dialog or write is started, and no registry function is called. Each call is its own snapshot SELECT expr FROM One. Fixture r-expr-1b-main is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
retentionNote: Designed r-expr-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
